bakeoff doctor
- claude: <WORKDIR>/fake-bin/claude (claude fake 1.0)
- codex: <WORKDIR>/fake-bin/codex (codex fake 1.0)
- git: /usr/bin/git (git version 2.39.5 (Apple Git-154))
- defaults:
  claude_sonnet: claude-sonnet-4-6
  claude_opus: claude-opus-4-7
  claude_haiku: claude-haiku-4-5-20251001
  codex: gpt-5.5
  codex_gpt5: gpt-5
- scope policy: best_effort by default; provider status records enforcement and advisory fallback.
- scope capabilities:
  claude: supports allowed_tools, disallowed_tools, tools, permission_mode
  codex: supports sandbox, disable_feature, profile, config, output_last_message
- cwd writable: ok (/private<WORKDIR>)
- bias: Default judge is claude/opus alongside claude/sonnet workers. Position-swap is the primary bias mitigation; same-family bias is an accepted v1 risk.
